rows.text: The log shows a CMake build of a C++ core library, compiling numerous source files (alloc, buffer, parser, socket, pool, codec, etc.) and generating many harmless “unused parameter ‘ctx’” warnings. The build ultimately fails because `socket.cpp` references an undefined symbol `connect_timeout`, causing a compilation error and aborting the make process.
